profile.headline: Senior Principal Software Engineer at Dell Technologies
profile.summary: Senior Principal Engineer | Agentic Systems, Distributed Software, Quantum Computing Research | Technical Leader & Inventor

positions.title: Senior Principal Software Engineer
positions.description: As a Senior Principal Software Engineer, I lead the exploration and adoption of emerging technologies, with a focus on Agentic AI, quantum computing, distributed systems, and modern software platforms. My work bridges research and product execution, transforming innovative concepts into scalable solutions that drive business outcomes. As an inventor and mentor, I am passionate about fostering technical excellence, cultivating future leaders, and advancing the state of the art in computing.

positions.title: Teacher Assistant
positions.description: Instructed students in Digital Signal Processing. Assisted with preparation of lesson plans and materials. Worked with students on individual and small group basis to reinforce concepts and help complete lab assignments.
